title: Open Error Notices and Personal Sender Account Statement Delivery
content:
For a statement requested on a Personal Sender Account, open error notices are the error notices given on the customer's Bank Deposit, Cash Pickup and Mobile Wallet transfers that carry no decision yet, counted in each delivery method as the error notices on record less the error decisions on record.

- When there are 2 or more open error notices, 2 business days are added to the counted statement window.
- When there is exactly 1, 1 business day is added to the counted statement window.
- When there is none, nothing is added for open error notices.

## How the count is made

For each delivery method separately, the open count is the error notices filed in the case files of the customer's transfers of that method less the error decisions recorded in those case files; the open error notices are the three counts added together. Every notice and decision on record counts, whatever its date.

| Delivery method | Error notices on record | Error decisions on record | Open |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bank Deposit | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| Cash Pickup | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| Mobile Wallet | 1 | 0 | 1 |
| **All three** | | | **2** |

In this hypothetical file the customer has 2 open error notices, so 2 business days are added. Had the Mobile Wallet notice been decided, the total would be 1 and 1 business day would be added; had every notice been decided, nothing would be added.
